hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. It intercepts swaps in beforeSwap, computes quotes using a proprietary bounded AMM curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from an Euler vault — bypassing standard concentrated liquidity entirely. Each pool instance is a minimal proxy delegating to a singleton EulerSwap implementation.
